name: Extraset · ES Park Mono

title.zh: Extraset · 比较字族样张与试排

description.zh: 看Park Mono等宽试排及字形控件，未下载或购买。 Extraset是位于日内瓦的瑞士独立字体厂牌，官网提供自家零售字族目录和大字样张；ES Park Mono详情可见试排、试用与购买控件。零售许可付费，具体用途与排除组织须按EULA另核，字体文件不等于制作源码。
description.en: Extraset is an independent Swiss type foundry based in Geneva. Its site presents a retail family catalog and large specimens, while ES Park Mono has testing, trial and purchase controls. Retail licenses are paid; usage permissions and excluded organizations require separate EULA checks. Font files do not establish access to production source.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Extraset (https://extraset.ch/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看Park Mono等宽试排及字形控件，未下载或购买。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先在首页看Park Mono等宽大字和Allianz样张，再到目录比较Build、Dokument等字族的风格数与CHF报价。ES Park Mono详情实际显示蓝色等宽长句，右侧有字重、斜体和字形功能控件，上方可见试用与购买入口。本次未下载、购买或逐项试切；零售付费不代表完整商用许可已核，具体用途及EULA排除组织仍须另查。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
